title: Fresh-format export of the confirmed Pulsar Analysis measurement list
sourceNote: CLEA_VEO.exe (VIREO). Static listings and decoded literals only; no original binary bytes are copied into the product.
scope: A new bounded web download built from confirmed web measurement rows and metadata the learner types. It is not the native Save, not the raw PLR recording writer, not append mode and not audio.
newline: CRLF after every line (WEB-NWE-03 policy; the native WriteLn flag at TextRec+6 is unknown)

limitTags.tableMax: S: ShortString caps 19 (0x570072) minus the 15-byte prefix 0x5703e4
limitTags.nameMax: S: identity append cap 0x29 after the opening quote (0x570100 and siblings)
limitTags.maxRowBytes: W: saved-rows reader bound; under every field cap the largest admissible row is 753 bytes

contracts.contract: An empty list is refused before any output.

contracts.code: none (no clock, locale or format is read)

Line 2 is the ShortString '"Table Number: ' with the table text appended under cap 19 and the closing quote under cap 20, so at most 4 table bytes.

contracts.contract: After a blank line the non-empty identity ShortStrings +0/+0x29/+0x52/+0x7b are written in slot order, each at most 40 bytes between quotes; then a blank line and the 151-byte header 0x570400.
contracts.code: buildResultsExport lines 3..5+k; refused above 40 bytes instead of truncated

contracts.contract: Every retained row string is copied by ordinal 0..count-1; duplicates and order are kept and no field is recomputed in the loop.
contracts.code: buildResultsExport rows; exportPulsarResults uses the stored row texts verbatim

contracts.contract: AnsiString and ShortString payloads are copied at exact length with no escaping; WriteLn appends CR LF when TextRec+6 bit 0 is set, else LF (flags from 0x5ae034); the runtime flag is unknown.
contracts.code: no escaping; CR LF is the declared WEB-NWE-03 policy

contracts.contract: The Record producer wraps object, comment and file in unescaped quotes, formats numbers with zero placeholders, eleven fields plus an optional file when header +0x96 is set.
contracts.code: existing web Record rows (src/core/pulsarAnalysis.ts); the export checks them against the strict profile and their stored fields

contracts.contract: The native writer closes the output and calls the measurement/comment reset 0x56fe6c; the append, open and error paths are distinct.
contracts.code: none: a download request changes no analysis state (WEB-NWE-04)

contracts.contract: A fresh-format interoperability download of confirmed web-generated rows under a strict lexical profile; not native Save, not the raw PLR writer, no historical equivalence.
Date and time texts, table and the four name lines are typed by the learner and start empty; no clock, catalog, login, classroom or guessed default.

Printable ASCII only; a '"' in metadata or an ambiguous quoted row field is refused; table at most 4, names at most 40, date/time at most 64; no silent truncation, escaping or repair; CR LF chosen output policy.
A download request does not prove a saved file: no saved flag, reset, pending reading, comment, list, cursor, dataset or Undo change. Native Save, append and the raw capture Yes stay gated.

Only the confirmed list is exported; pending readings and staged Review copies are excluded. Modal, snapshot, generation, lease and read guards; hidden route keeps the draft; Cancel, repeats and failures change nothing; no new persistence.
